svg.text: in / out from the court lines
tensor sizes from the shipped converters · a, d, e run on device as Core ML · b, c, f are geometry and state
(a) GridTrackNet takes five frames and predicts a coarse confidence grid with sub-cell offsets. (b) A homography from
four court keypoints maps detections to metres. (c) Bounces are sign flips of vertical velocity. (d) MoveNet gives 17
keypoints per frame. (e) A GRU classifies 30-frame pose windows into four classes (probabilities shown are
illustrative). (f) A state machine turns events into rallies and a score.
